505498.name: Solčany
505498.note: The page of the municipal by-elections 2026 lists no okrsky document (call, information, commission documents and minutes only). The municipality's okrsky documents (e.g. 2024 presidential) name only the polling stations, no streets.

517488.name: Divina
517488.note: Divina's okrsky 1 and 2 split the part Divina (whose houses have súpisné čísla only) into 'dolný koniec' and 'horný koniec'; the documents the municipality publishes (2022 resolution 40/2022 and announcement, 2026 Oznámenie, divina.sk) name the okrsky/obvody without listing houses, so no rules can be written; no document of this vote listing houses was found on divina.sk. The Internet Archive refused connections (offline) during the search.
